CWE-693.remediation: Define a strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header restricting script-src and object-src to trusted origins.

CWE-319.remediation: Enable Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) with 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' and enforce HTTPS redirects.

CWE-1021.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames
CWE-1021.remediation: Set 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' and configure CSP 'frame-ancestors'.

CWE-614.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
CWE-614.remediation: Configure session cookies with 'Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax' (or Strict).

CWE-16.remediation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to all application HTTP responses.
